findings.reason: finally at index.js:116 belongs to pDebounce.promise; abort-listener removal at :51 belongs to pDebounce. The finding only establishes file-level co-occurrence, not one cancellation chain.
setTimeout at :41 is a debounce window. Its presence must not be interpreted as confirmed retry/poll behavior.

Abort while waiting and abort after invocation have distinct behavior; upstream test.js:1270 and the controlled probe confirm this distinction for the checked cases. Scanner does not recover it automatically.
Argument validation and local writes enter the same evidence set; this is not evidence that a particular effect is protected.

missed_structure.description: Set currentPromise before invoking the supplied function to protect synchronous reentry. Existing four findings do not explicitly present this protection relation. This example is not a measured recall rate.
